description: Old repository path -> current path for every file moved in the 2026-11-01 journal-neutral migration. Data, artifacts and reports were moved byte-identical (sha256 = content hash before and after the move). Scripts, tests and manuscript/source/01_si.md were moved with git mv and then had internal path references updated, so for those the sha256 here is the pre-move content hash. Frozen records (locks, specs, historical reports) are never edited; their old path strings resolve through this map.
